english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for acting or operating independently without outside control.

examples.english: Our team operates autonomously, without needing approval from management for everything.
examples.traditional: 我哋個團隊自己話事咁運作，唔使上面樣樣嘢都批准。
